newsitem.title: FRANCE: BA expects Air Liberte decision on Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: BA expects Air Liberte decision on Oct 30.

text.p: British Airways and its French subsidiary TAT filed their plan to take over Air Liberte in conjunction with Banque Rivaud and expect a court decision on Wednesday, spokespersons at BA and TAT said on Monday.
Air Liberte, which has a 12 percent share of the French domestic market, filed for receivership at the Creteil commercial court on September 26.
Court officials were not available to comment on other bids.
Nouvelles Frontieres chairman Jacques Maillot withdrew from the bidding last week after a dispute with partner Banque Rivaud over the financing.
Banque Rivaud linked up with British Airways to propose a new offer which was filed with the court on Friday, a spokeswoman with BA's French headquarters told Reuters.
"The tribunal meets on Wednesday to decide whether to liquidate Air Liberte or give it to one of the bidders," she said.
Richard Branson's Virgin Express said last week it would raise its bid for Air Liberte but declined to give any figures.
